title: Najib-ud-Daula Pays Tribute and Receives Authority

blocks.text: This hinge page turns from Jawahar Mal's settlement back to Abdali's imperial arrangements. Listen further to the account about Ahmad Shah Abdali: once matters have been stabilized, Najibu-ud-Daula proceeded to pay a visit and acknowledge the ruler whose intervention preserved him.
The meeting is formal and political. Najib placed his offerings before Abdali, thanks him for rescue, and is rewarded with favor that confirms his standing in the north after the recent crisis.

From that audience come administrative decisions that shape the next conflict. Abdali is described as making him his deputy to rule over Delhi while also arranging that Rohilla's own troops be stationed at Sirhind, a move aimed at containing Sikh power on the Punjab frontier.
